_doc: Snap-role projection adjustment (statline_model.snap_role_adjust_pts, applied by build_projections_statline._apply_snap_role right after WRW WR, post-stack). Per RB/WR/TE row with same-season snap history: adj = design(use+snap).full - design(use).base, design = per-position intercept + use_l1/use_l3/use_jump (+ snap_l1/snap_l3/snap_jump) x position; i.e. only what PFR snap share adds on top of the usage-share lags (spec S2). Clipped to +/-clip_pts, added to final_projection and p10/p90; ownership is computed on final_projection - snap_adj_pts. Fit: OLS of (actual DK pts - current-code OFF final_projection) on all 2021-25 RB/WR/TE eval rows with snap history (20,520 of 26,109 rows, 86 DK main slates, analysis/wrw_compounding_vacancy/hist_builds/fixed) -- the FULL-history fit (analysis/snap_role_projection_confirm/fit_s2.py fit_pair(H); matches data/coefs_s2.json full_all/base_all to 5e-5). Held out LOSO: RMSE 5.389->5.371, MAE 3.594->3.557, 5/5 seasons, pipeline placebo null. 2026 wk2-6 did not confirm (dMSE +0.03 [-.03,+.12]); shipped ON by owner decision 2026-10-22, re-grade after wk9. The three snap terms are collinear: read predictions, not signs. Off: DFS_PROJ_SNAP=0.
